articles.summary: Lionsgate (NYSE: LION) and SP Media, led by longtime producer, financier and entrepreneur Steven Paul, today announced the formation of a joint venture through which SP Media will make a significant capital investment to co-invest in new ventures that expand and grow the Lionsgate platform as well as extending resources toward the continuing diversification of 3 Arts and other Lionsgate businesses. SP Media will also produce independent feature films that Lionsgate will distribute. The relationship will be managed through a joint venture majority owned and controlled by Lionsgate. The agreement allows Lionsgate to continue scaling its content platform with a new source of independent feature films. The collaboration allows SP Media to partner with one of the world's leading independent standalone studios, and it gives SP a world-class distributor for its films. articles.summary: Lionsgate (NYSE: LION) today announced it will release its financial results for the fiscal 2027 second quarter ended September 30, 2026 after market close on Thursday, November 5. Lionsgate senior management will hold its analyst and investor conference call to discuss its fiscal 2027 second quarter at 5:00 P.M. ET/2:00 P.M. PT on Thursday, November 5. Interested parties may listen to the live webcast by visiting the events page on the Lionsgate Investor relations website or via the following link . A full replay will be available starting Thursday evening, November 5, by clicking the same link.
